canonical_project: Hormuud Telecom data center network (11 sites, ~10 MW portfolio)
notes: CEO statements (Bloomberg/DCD Dec 2024, mirrored by Stallion Times/Garowe Online) cite 11 data centers with combined ~10 MW capacity and up to 95% daytime solar. Portfolio-level claim; per-site addresses/capacities not published. Mogadishu (Banaadir) is the core hub; the DARE1 cable landing station (completed Nov 2022) is an interconnect anchor, not a DC. Do not mint 11 facility records from the aggregate (methodology rule).
